about.title: From nightlife to *code*
about.p1: I spent 11 years in hospitality and nightlife: bartender, then party producer in Rio de Janeiro. That's where I learned to solve problems under pressure and to take good care of people.
about.p2: Looking for work I could do from home, I discovered programming, and today I build websites, automations and AI agents.
about.p3: Noctua was born from that experience: I saw nightlife from the inside and built the tool that was missing.

services.title: I also take *freelance* projects

landing.title: Landing pages

automation.title: n8n automations
